wa_roger_s_corner.notes: Own route; the main line of the Roger's Corner area. Stored grade 5.9 agrees with MP and the Index guide (agree-2). Length 37 m vs MP 120 ft (36 m): within tolerance, locked-1src. PITCHES: stored 1; MP's author clipped a mid-way chain anchor (~60 ft, ~20 m) and ran it in one pitch to the tree (~35 m), and suggests two raps with a 60 m rope (a 70 m reaches the ground). Not a stated count, so pitches 1 is left as is, no ledger entry. FA DEFECT (report only): the fa string mixes the FA (Greg Donaldson, Roger Johnson, Richard Mathies, 4/1967) and the FFA (Bob Crawford, Don Harder, 9/1974) while the ffa column is empty; MP gives both. No second publisher found (theCrag Forbidden; SummitPost not tried per BRIEF-C). Anchor: MP mentions chains at mid-height and rap rings by the tree, with fixed biner lower-offs added 2022; no single house type, not proposed. RELATIONS: Breakfast of Champions (wa_breakfast_of_champions) and Marginal Karma (wa_marginal_karma) start from its top ledge; Sugar Bear (wa_sugar_bear) moves right out of it. No safety warning on the MP page; the generic stored hazard line is unchanged.
